rootMotion: remove_old bakes a diagonal backward-left step to Root[-0.35,0,-0.28]; mount_new returns to Root zero. No Root yaw. Apply Root exactly once, no external additive shift.

attachmentRules.wheel: preserve world transform at handoff; LeftHand primary parent; RightHand secondary grip; offsets solved from decoded wrist transforms
attachmentRules.gun: RightHand during loosen/tighten; Hips belt holster during two-hand tire work; socket targets hub
attachmentRules.jack: floor-local Base, animated LiftArm and LiftPad; both car lift pads must support before nut release
attachmentRules.oldTire: Pull axially then release at remove_old +0.20s into catch tray, continuously integrate drop/roll
attachmentRules.newTire: Starts in separate raised tray; grip at mount_new +0.00s; RightHand secondary grip releases at +0.26s; LeftHand seats at +0.36s; do not reuse old tire identity

qaNotes.compositeWork: Stationary service interspersed with a stance adjustment, not a continuous gait. Composite foot support is measured throughout. remove_old and mount_new individually declare locomotion=true and measure body/step agreement.
